entries.definition: written in a style natural to the Python language
entries.definitionCN: 符合 Python 编程风格的

entries.definition: a very short person
entries.definitionCN: 矮人；侏儒族（只是以 p 与 y 起头，词源不同）

entries.definition: a very large South American snake that squeezes its prey
entries.definitionCN: 水蟒；森蚺

entries.definition: a large non-venomous snake that crushes its prey
entries.definitionCN: 蟒；蚺

entries.definition: a poisonous snake that spreads a hood around its neck
entries.definitionCN: 眼镜蛇

normalIntro.en: Python is a borrowed name for a giant snake, and Greek myth explains how a serpent got it.
normalIntro.cn: python 是一个借来的巨蛇名字，希腊神话给出了一条巨蛇得到这个名字的由来。

normal.en: The Burmese python is one of the best-known species of the word.
normal.cn: 缅甸蟒是这个词最著名的物种之一。

normal.en: In myth, Apollo killed the Python that guarded Delphi.
normal.cn: 神话中阿波罗杀死了守护德尔斐的巨蟒皮同。

normal.en: Biologists write Python in capital letters when it is a genus name.
normal.cn: 作为属名时，生物学家把 Python 首字母大写。

normal.en: The programming language Python is named after a comedy group, not the snake.
normal.cn: 编程语言 Python 取名于一个喜剧团体，与蛇无关。

normal.en: Compare python and anaconda: both squeeze prey, but the anaconda lives in South America.
normal.cn: 对比 python 与 anaconda：两种蛇都用缠绕方式捕食，但森蚺生活在南美。

abstract.en: Picture a thick patterned body slowly winding around a branch.
abstract.cn: 想象一条粗大斑纹的身躯慢慢缠上树枝。

abstract.en: Imagine two bright yellow eyes in a dark tree hole.
abstract.cn: 想象昏暗的树洞里露出两只亮黄色的眼睛。

abstract.en: Picture a long line of small green brackets falling down a screen like a snake.
abstract.cn: 想象屏幕上成串的绿色小括号像蛇一样顺着往下流。

examples.en: A python can swallow an animal far wider than its head.
examples.cn: 蟒蛇能吞下比它的头宽得多的动物。

examples.en: The park warns visitors that pythons may hide in the tall grass.
examples.cn: 公园提醒游客蟒蛇可能藏在深草里。

examples.en: He taught himself Python because it reads almost like plain English.
examples.cn: 他自学了 Python，因为它的代码读起来几乎像普通的英文。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「派森」——蟒蛇潜进雨「森」林，程序员写的代码也叫这个名；这只是谐音联想，与希腊神话中的巨蛇名无关。

root: 希腊语 Python（德尔斐神话中的巨蛇）→ 拉丁语 Python（巨蛇；龙形怪兽）→ 英语 python（蟒蛇；蟒属）；更早的词根一般与「腐烂」相关，但属重构推测，来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Python begins as the name of a mythic giant serpent, then becomes the zoological name for squeezing snakes, and later spreads to heraldry, computing, and a tropical tree.
sensesIntro.cn: python 起初是神话中巨蛇的名字，后来成为动物学里缠绕捕食的大蛇之名，再扩展到纹章、计算机和一种热带树木。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick giant snake coiled around a branch with its prey squeezed inside.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条粗大的巨蛇盘在树枝上，猎物被它一圈圈勒住。

branches.en: The everyday sense names a large snake that kills by coiling.
branches.cn: 日常义指靠缠绕杀死猎物的大蛇。

branches.en: Science takes the word as the formal name of a genus.
branches.cn: 科学界把这个词用作业群的正式属名。

branches.en: The Greek story of the serpent at Delphi is the oldest layer.
branches.cn: 希腊关于德尔斐巨蛇的故事是最古老的一层。

branches.en: Heraldry extends the giant snake into painted dragon heads.
branches.cn: 纹章学把巨蛇的意象延伸到画出来的龙形头部。

branches.en: The two loaned names for a language and a tree reuse the spelling in unrelated fields.
branches.cn: 一种语言和一种树的借名，在同一拼写下用于互不相关的领域。

intro.en: Python is a borrowed naming word without a productive English prefix, but it builds pythonic and pythoness.
intro.cn: python 是一个借来的命名词，没有能产的英语前缀，但派生出 pythonic 与 pythoness。

latinIntro.en: Latin Python is the same name as the Greek mythic serpent, borrowed rather than formed from a prefix and a root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 Python 与希腊神话巨蛇同名，是借入的专名，而非由前缀和词根组合而成。

items.example: Python begins as a name rather than a description.
items.exampleCN: python 最初是一个专名，而不是描述性词语。

items.meaning: a noun ending in borrowed Greek names
items.meaningCN: 希腊借词中常见的名词结尾
items.example: The ending -on is common in Greek loans.
items.exampleCN: 结尾 -on 在希腊语借词中很常见。

items.example: The suffix -ic forms pythonic.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ic 构成 pythonic。

items.meaning: in the style of Python code
items.example: Pythonic describes clean Python code.
items.exampleCN: pythonic 形容简洁的 Python 代码。

items.example: The suffix -ess forms pythoness.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ess 构成 pythoness。

items.example: Pythoness is a rare literary word.
items.exampleCN: pythoness 是少见的文学用词。

items.example: Anaconda is a near relative in meaning.
items.exampleCN: anaconda 是意义相近的同类词。

items.meaning: a snake that crushes its prey
items.example: Boa and python share the squeezing habit.
items.exampleCN: boa 与 python 都有缠绕捕食的习性。

definition_zh: 困惑；窘境；左右为难的处境；难以抉择的局面
definition_en: a state of uncertainty in which it is very hard to decide what to do, often because none of the choices looks good
core_image: 站在岔路口的人，每条路都看不清尽头，脚抬起来却迟迟不落下
scene: 凌晨的办公室里，合同还剩半小时到期，签与不签都有风险，经理盯着笔一动不动。The manager was in a quandary about whether to sign the contract or let the deadline pass.
sceneCN: 这里 quandary 是「左右为难的处境」（第 1 个义项：难以决定下一步的困惑状态）；句意：经理在签约还是放任截止日期过去之间左右为难。

pos.zh: 困惑；窘境；左右为难的处境

collocations.phrase: a quandary about what to do
collocations.zh: 对下一步该做什么感到困惑

derivatives.zh: 目标词的复数形式，指多个两难处境；除此以外现代英语几乎没有其它派生形式
由 un- 与 certain 加 -ty 构成，义为「不确定」，是 quandary 的近义替换词
源自希腊语前缀 di- 意为「二」与 lemma 意为「前提」，指只能在两个坏选项中挑一个

senses.title: A state of being unable to decide
senses.definition: a state of uncertainty in which you cannot decide what to do
senses.definitionCN: 拿不定主意、无法决定下一步该做什么的状态
senses.example: She was in a quandary about which offer to accept.
senses.exampleCN: 她为该接受哪个录用通知而左右为难。
senses.why: The word first named a state of perplexity, so the core sense is the stuck feeling inside the mind rather than the choice itself.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初就指一种困惑的状态，所以核心义是脑子里的卡住感，而不是选择本身。

senses.title: A difficult situation with no good choice
senses.definition: an awkward situation caused by having to choose between options that all seem bad
senses.definitionCN: 必须在看起来都不好的选项之间作选择所造成的尴尬处境
senses.example: Rising rents have left many students in a quandary.
senses.exampleCN: 房租上涨让许多学生陷入了窘境。
senses.why: Once the stuck feeling is caused by outside factors, the word shifts from the mind to the situation that traps the person.
senses.whyCN: 当这种卡住的感觉由外部因素造成时，词义就从内心状态转到困住人的外部处境。

senses.title: A moral or ethical puzzle
senses.definition: a situation in which the right course of action is unclear because duties conflict
senses.definitionCN: 义务相互冲突、不清楚哪种做法才算正确的处境
senses.example: Doctors often face a quandary over how much to tell a patient.
senses.exampleCN: 医生常常为该告诉病人多少实情而陷入困境。
senses.why: When the competing options are duties rather than conveniences, the puzzle becomes ethical and the word takes on a formal, serious tone.
senses.whyCN: 当对立的选项是义务而不是便利时，这种困惑就带上了伦理色彩，词的语气也随之正式而郑重。

senses.title: A puzzling question or problem
senses.definition: a complicated question or problem that is hard to answer or solve
senses.definitionCN: 难以回答或解决的复杂问题
senses.example: How to fund the research remains a quandary for the team.
senses.exampleCN: 如何给这项研究筹资，仍是团队的一道难题。
senses.why: The stuck state can be turned outward into a thing, so quandary sometimes names the problem itself rather than the person facing it.
senses.whyCN: 卡住的状态可以被外化成一件东西，所以 quandary 有时指问题本身，而不是面对问题的人。

intro.en: Quandary is a rare case of a word whose origin is unknown; it appears in English in the late sixteenth century with no certain source.
intro.cn: quandary 是少数来源确实不明的词之一：它在十六世纪后期进入英语，来源至今没有定论。

items.en: The Latin scholar Erasmus used the rare word quando, meaning when, in a work on war, which could have circulated as a tag.
items.cn: 拉丁学者伊拉斯谟在一部论战争的著作中用过生僻词 quando（何时），它可能作为流行短句流传开来。

items.en: Some writers link the word to French-derived forms of the Latin tag, though no French source is firmly established.
items.cn: 部分作者把该词与上述拉丁短语的法语化形式联系起来，但目前没有确定可靠的法语来源。

items.en: Most modern dictionaries simply record the origin as unknown and reject the older guesses as unproven.
items.cn: 多数现代词典干脆把词源记为「不明」，并认为早年那些猜测都无法证实。

items.en: The noun is first recorded as a state of perplexity, close to its modern core meaning.
items.cn: 该名词最早记录于十六世纪后期，指困惑的状态，与现代核心义很接近。

items.en: The sense widens from inner confusion to an awkward situation that traps a person.
items.cn: 词义从内心的困惑扩展为把人困住的尴尬处境。

items.en: Today it appears mainly in formal and journalistic writing, usually in the frame of being in a quandary.
items.cn: 今天它主要用于正式与新闻报道文体，常出现在「陷入两难」这类框架里。

note.en: Quandary is an odd-looking noun with no obvious family, so its look-alikes are mainly other -ary or qu- words and its neighbours are decision and problem nouns.
note.cn: quandary 是个外形奇特、没有明显同族词的词，所以形近组多收 -ary 结尾或 qu- 开头的词，近义组则收表示决策与问题的名词。

entries.definition: a question or doubt
entries.definitionCN: 疑问；询问；只是拼写与发音相近，词源不同

entries.definition: an angry argument
entries.definitionCN: 争吵；同样以 qu- 开头、含 -ar- 音组，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a pit from which stone is cut
entries.definitionCN: 采石场；词首词尾都很像，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a difficult choice between two bad options
entries.definitionCN: 两难；必须在两个都不好的选项间挑选

entries.definition: a difficult or embarrassing situation
entries.definitionCN: 困境；尴尬的局面

entries.definition: the state of being confused
entries.definitionCN: 困惑；迷惑，偏重精神上的迷惑

normalIntro.en: Quandary is a formal noun for being stuck between choices, and it almost always appears inside the frame of being in a quandary.
normalIntro.cn: quandary 是表示「卡在选项之间」的正式名词，几乎总是出现在「陷入两难」这个框架里。

normal.en: The standard frame is be in a quandary about or over something.
normal.cn: 最标准的框架是「be in a quandary about / over」：为某事左右为难。

normal.en: Quandary is uncountable in this frame, so we say in a quandary rather than in quandaries.
normal.cn: 在这个框架里它近似不可数，说「in a quandary」而不用复数形式。

normal.en: Plural quandaries works when you mean several separate difficult choices.
normal.cn: 复数 quandaries 用于指若干个各自独立的两难抉择。

normal.en: Dilemma stresses the two options, while quandary stresses the stuck feeling.
normal.cn: dilemma 强调两个选项，而 quandary 强调卡住、拿不定主意的感觉。

normal.en: Because the origin is unknown, no reliable memory hook comes from its root; remember it by its frame instead.
normal.cn: 因为词源不明，没法从词根找可靠的记忆点，最好靠固定框架来记。

abstract.en: Picture a person holding a pen above a contract, unable to sign.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人把笔悬在合同上方，迟迟签不下去。

abstract.en: Picture a room with every door half open and none of them lit.
abstract.cn: 想象一间房，每扇门都半开着，却没有一扇亮着灯。

abstract.en: Picture a scale with two weights that keep rocking back and forth.
abstract.cn: 想象一架天平，两侧砝码来回摇摆、始终不平。

examples.en: The proposal left the committee in a quandary.
examples.cn: 这份提案让委员会陷入两难。

examples.en: Parents are often in a quandary about how strict to be.
examples.cn: 父母常常在管教该多严格的问题上左右为难。

examples.en: Faced with a moral quandary, he asked for advice.
examples.cn: 面对道德上的困境，他寻求了建议。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「框得理」——框住了道理，怎么让人服气都说不清，于是左右为难；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 词源来源不确定：一般认为与拉丁学者伊拉斯谟所用的 quando（何时）有关，可能经法语进入英语；多数现代词典把来源记为「不明」，因此不宜编造词根。

sensesIntro.en: Quandary starts from the inner stuck feeling, then extends to the situation that causes it, to dilemmas of duty, and finally to the puzzle itself.
sensesIntro.cn: quandary 从内心的卡住感出发，再扩展到造成这种感觉的处境、义务上的两难，最后指难题本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person at a fork in the road, unsure which way leads anywhere.
core.cn: 核心意象：岔路口上的人，不知道哪条路能走得通。

branches.en: The inability to decide is the core, inner sense.
branches.cn: 无法决定是核心的内心义项。

branches.en: The awkward situation is the outward sense.
branches.cn: 尴尬处境是向外的义项。

branches.en: A moral quandary is the ethical branch.
branches.cn: 道德困境是伦理这一分支。

branches.en: The puzzling problem is the thing-focused branch.
branches.cn: 令人费解的难题是以问题为中心的义项。

branches.en: Inner hesitation and outer predicament usually appear together.
branches.cn: 内心的犹豫与外在的困境通常同时出现。

intro.en: Quandary is a single unanalysable stem with no productive parts, so the family here is built from its formal frame and its near synonyms.
intro.cn: quandary 是不可拆分的单一词干，没有能产的构词成分，所以这里的词族主要借它的正式框架与近义词来看。

latinIntro.en: The only Latin link is the disputed use of quando, meaning when, from which some writers derive the word; nothing is confirmed.
latinIntro.cn: 唯一与拉丁语的联系是有争议的 quando（何时），有人据此推断词源，但并未得到确认。

items.example: Quando appears in a famous tag as a disputed source.
items.exampleCN: quando 出现在一个著名短语中，被当作有争议的词源。

items.meaning: a state of not being able to decide
items.example: The noun keeps this meaning from the sixteenth century.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词从十六世纪起就保持这一含义。

items.example: The plural replaces the final y with ies.
items.exampleCN: 复数把词尾的 y 变成 ies。

items.example: This frame carries most of the word usage.
items.exampleCN: 这个框架承载了这个词的大部分用法。

items.example: The compound adds a formal ethical tone.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合结构增添了正式的伦理色彩。

items.meaning: a choice between two bad options
items.example: Dilemma is the closest near synonym.
items.exampleCN: dilemma 是最接近的近义词。

items.example: Predicament stresses the situation itself.
items.exampleCN: predicament 侧重处境本身。

items.example: Perplexity stresses mental confusion.
items.exampleCN: perplexity 侧重精神上的迷惑。

items.meaning: the state of not being sure
items.example: Uncertainty is a broader paraphrase.
items.exampleCN: uncertainty 是更宽泛的替换说法。

definition_zh: 爱争吵的；好吵架的；爱挑事的；脾气火爆的
definition_en: tending to argue or start fights, and quick to take offence at small things
core_image: 为一只橘子推让不休的两个人，谁也不肯先松口
scene: 晚饭桌上，亲戚为谁先动筷子又吵起来，声音一阵高过一阵。The quarrelsome uncle turned a simple dinner into another shouting match.
sceneCN: 这里 quarrelsome 是「爱争吵的」（第 1 个义项：动不动就和人吵起来）；句意：那位好争吵的叔叔又把一顿家常饭变成了吵闹的场面。

pos.zh: 爱争吵的；好吵架的；爱挑事的

derivatives.zh: 基础词，义为「争吵；吵嘴」，-some 加在其后构成形容词
由 quarrelsome 加 -ness 构成，义为「爱争吵的性情」
由 argument 加 -ative（倾向……的）构成，义为「好争辩的」，是 quarrelsome 的近义替换词
由拉丁语 belligerare（交战）加 -ent 构成，义为「好斗的」，比 quarrelsome 更强调敌意

senses.title: Often starting arguments
senses.definition: often starting arguments with other people, even over small matters
senses.definitionCN: 常常和别人起争执，连小事也要争
senses.example: He grew quarrelsome as the meeting dragged on.
senses.exampleCN: 会议拖得越久，他就越爱争辩。
senses.why: The suffix -some means full of or tending to, so quarrelsome literally means full of quarrelling.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -some 表示「充满……的、倾向……的」，所以 quarrelsome 字面意思就是「满是争吵」。

senses.title: Quick to take offence
senses.definition: easily upset or irritated by what others say or do
senses.definitionCN: 容易因别人的言行而不快或被激怒
senses.example: A quarrelsome customer complained about every dish.
senses.exampleCN: 一位爱挑刺的顾客把每道菜都抱怨了一遍。
senses.why: If someone is full of quarrelling, they are primed to read offence into small things, so the word also describes a quick temper.
senses.whyCN: 一个人若「满是争吵」，就会从小事里读出冒犯，所以这个词也用来形容脾气急躁易怒。

senses.title: Prone to disorder
senses.definition: describing a group, place, or period made restless by constant disputes
senses.definitionCN: 形容因不断争执而不得安宁的群体、地方或时期
senses.example: The town had a quarrelsome reputation during the border dispute.
senses.exampleCN: 边界争端期间，这座小镇落下了纷争不断的名声。
senses.why: The adjective can be lifted from people to the group they form, so a whole community can be called quarrelsome.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词可以从个人推广到人所组成的群体，于是整个社区也能被说成「纷争不断」。

intro.en: Quarrelsome joins the noun quarrel with the old suffix -some, and quarrel itself comes from Latin querela, a complaint.
intro.cn: quarrelsome 由名词 quarrel 加上古老的词尾 -some 构成，而 quarrel 本身来自拉丁语 querela（抱怨）。

items.en: Querela means a complaint or a lament, from queri, to complain.
items.cn: querela 意为抱怨或哀诉，源于动词 queri（抱怨）。

items.en: Querele, meaning a dispute or complaint, carries the word into French.
items.cn: 古法语 querele 意为争端或申诉，把这个词带入法语。

items.en: Querel appears in English as a complaint or a dispute between people.
items.cn: 中古英语 querel 指申诉，或人与人之间的争端。

items.en: The suffix -some, meaning tending to or full of, is added to form quarrelsome.
items.cn: 加上意为「倾向……、充满……」的词尾 -some，构成 quarrelsome。

items.en: The adjective settles on describing a person who is always ready to argue.
items.cn: 这个形容词固定下来，用来形容随时准备争吵的人。

note.en: Quarrelsome sits with -some adjectives and with quarrel family words, and in meaning it competes with argumentative and combative.
note.cn: quarrelsome 一方面与 -some 结尾的形容词及 quarrel 词族相邻，另一方面在意义上与 argumentative、combative 竞争。

entries.definition: an angry argument or to argue angrily
entries.definitionCN: 争吵；吵嘴，是 quarrelsome 的基础词

entries.definition: the quality of being quarrelsome
entries.definitionCN: 爱争吵的性情

entries.definition: annoying and tiring
entries.definitionCN: 令人厌烦的；同样以 -some 结尾，词根不同

entries.definition: fond of arguing
entries.definitionCN: 好争辩的；偏重于讲道理式的争论

entries.definition: eager to fight or oppose
entries.definitionCN: 好斗的；喜欢对抗的

entries.definition: bad-tempered and hard to please
entries.definitionCN: 脾气坏、爱发牢骚的

normalIntro.en: Quarrelsome is quarrel plus the suffix -some, so the adjective describes a person full of quarrels.
normalIntro.cn: quarrelsome 就是 quarrel 加上词尾 -some，所以这个形容词形容「满是争吵」的人。

normal.en: The suffix -some also appears in tiresome, troublesome, and awesome.
normal.cn: 词尾 -some 还见于 tiresome、troublesome 与 awesome。

normal.en: Quarrel comes from Latin querela, a complaint, so the link is complaining rather than hitting.
normal.cn: quarrel 源自拉丁语 querela（抱怨），所以这个词的底子是「抱怨」而不是「动手」。

normal.en: Use more quarrelsome rather than quarrelsomer, because the -er comparative is rare here.
normal.cn: 比较级用 more quarrelsome 而不用 quarrelsomer，因为这里加 -er 很罕见。

normal.en: Quarrelsome suits people and their moods; for events use quarrel or dispute.
normal.cn: quarrelsome 多形容人和脾气；指事件时用 quarrel 或 dispute。

normal.en: Compare argumentative, which sounds more about reasoning in an argument.
normal.cn: 对比 argumentative，它听起来更像在争论中讲道理。

abstract.en: Picture two people tugging at one orange, neither letting go.
abstract.cn: 想象两个人抢一只橘子，谁都不肯松手。

abstract.en: Picture a person with raised eyebrows, ready to object to anything.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人眉毛一挑，准备反驳任何事。

abstract.en: Picture a table of relatives whose voices rise into a chorus of complaints.
abstract.cn: 想象一桌亲戚，声音一路升成一片抱怨。

examples.en: Our quarrelsome neighbours argue about parking every week.
examples.cn: 我们那爱争吵的邻居每周都为停车吵架。

examples.en: Lack of sleep makes children quarrelsome.
examples.cn: 睡眠不足会让孩子变得爱闹脾气。

examples.en: She avoided the quarrelsome part of the discussion.
examples.cn: 她避开了讨论中容易起争执的那部分。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「夸了嗓」——一开口就抬高嗓门，夸夸其谈地争，就成了爱争吵的样子；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 queri（抱怨）→ querela（抱怨、申诉）→ 古法语 querele → 中古英语 querel → quarrel（争吵），再加词尾 -some（充满……的）构成 quarrelsome。

sensesIntro.en: Quarrelsome moves from a habit of arguing, to a quick temper at small things, and then to whole groups or periods full of disputes.
sensesIntro.cn: quarrelsome 从爱争吵的习惯，扩展到为小事动气的脾气，再扩展到充满纷争的群体或时期。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two people tugging at one orange, neither letting go.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个人抢一只橘子，谁都不肯松口。

branches.en: The habit of arguing is the core adjective sense.
branches.cn: 爱争吵的习惯是核心义项。

branches.en: A quick temper is the person-focused extension.
branches.cn: 爱动气是聚焦于人的延伸义项。

branches.en: A group full of disputes is the collective extension.
branches.cn: 纷争不断的群体是集体层面的延伸义项。

branches.en: A quarrelsome person both starts fights and takes offence quickly.
branches.cn: 爱争吵的人既主动挑事，也容易动气。

branches.en: One quick temper can set the tone for a whole quarrelsome town.
branches.cn: 一个人的火爆脾气能定下整座纷争小镇的基调。

intro.en: Quarrelsome is built from the noun quarrel and the suffix -some, and the family grows through -ness and the verb quarrel.
intro.cn: quarrelsome 由名词 quarrel 与词尾 -some 构成，词族通过 -ness 与动词 quarrel 继续生长。

latinIntro.en: Latin querela and the verb queri lie behind quarrel, so the complaint root is genuinely Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 querela 与动词 queri 是 quarrel 的来源，所以「抱怨」这个词根确实来自拉丁语。

items.example: Queri gives the complaint image behind quarrel.
items.exampleCN: queri 提供 quarrel 背后「抱怨」的意象。

items.example: Querela is the direct Latin source of quarrel.
items.exampleCN: querela 是 quarrel 的直接拉丁来源。

definition_en: an open pit where stone is cut from the ground; also a chosen prey or target that someone hunts or pursues

sceneCN: 这里 quarry 是「采石场」（第 1 个义项：从地面开采石头的露天空场）；句意：卡车正停在旧采石场旁装载切好的石块。

senses.title: An open pit for cutting stone
senses.definition: a place, usually an open pit, where stone is cut from the ground for building
senses.definitionCN: 从地面开采建筑用石的场地，通常是露天的坑
senses.example: The quarry supplied stone for the whole village.
senses.exampleCN: 这座采石场为整个村子供应石料。
senses.why: The core sense still carries the Latin idea of squared blocks, because a quarry is where stone is cut into regular shapes.
senses.whyCN: 核心义仍保留拉丁语「方形石块」的意思，因为采石场正是把石头切成规整形状的地方。

senses.title: To extract stone
senses.definition: to cut or dig stone, marble, or similar material out of the ground
senses.definitionCN: 从地里开采出石头、大理石或类似材料
senses.example: The marble was quarried near the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 这些大理石是在海岸附近开采的。
senses.why: From the place the word easily turns into the action done there, so the noun becomes the verb to quarry.
senses.whyCN: 从「场所」很容易转成「在该场所做的事」，于是名词又变成动词「开采」。

senses.title: An animal being hunted
senses.definition: an animal that is being hunted, especially one chosen as prey
senses.definitionCN: 正在被猎捕的动物，尤指被选作猎物的那一只
senses.example: The hawk kept its quarry in sight.
senses.exampleCN: 鹰一直盯着自己的猎物。
senses.why: This sense comes from a different Old French word for the parts of a hunted animal given to the hounds, so it shares the spelling but not the origin.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自另一个法语词，指分给猎犬的猎获物内脏，所以拼写相同但词源不同。

senses.title: A person or thing being pursued
senses.definition: a person or thing that is being chased or sought by someone
senses.definitionCN: 被某人追赶或寻找的人或事物
senses.example: Detectives finally found their quarry in a small hotel.
senses.exampleCN: 侦探们终于在一家小旅馆里找到了追捕对象。
senses.why: The hunting sense widens by metaphor, so police, reporters, and researchers all have a quarry.
senses.whyCN: 猎物义通过比喻而拓宽，所以警察、记者和研究者都可以有「追捕对象」。

intro.en: Quarry is really two words in one: the stone pit comes from Old French quarriere, while the hunted prey comes from a separate Old French word, and the two spellings fell together.
intro.cn: quarry 其实是两个词合并：采石场义来自古法语 quarriere，猎物义另有来源，两个词的拼写后来合而为一。

items.en: Quadrare means to make square, from quadrus, a square stone.
items.cn: quadrare 意为「使成方形」，源于 quadrus（方形石块）。

items.en: Quarriere, from the Latin squaring idea, names a place where stone is cut.
items.cn: 古法语 quarriere 承袭拉丁语「使成方形」的观念，指切取石料的场所。

items.en: Another Old French word, coree, names the inner parts of a hunted animal given to the hounds.
items.cn: 另一个古法语词 coree 指分给猎犬的猎获物内脏。

items.en: Both strands enter English and their spellings merge into quarry.
items.cn: 两支来源先后进入英语，拼写合并为 quarry。

items.en: The stone sense grows a verb, and the hunting sense extends to any target being chased.
items.cn: 石料义派生出动词，猎物义则扩展到任何被追逐的目标。

note.en: Quarry has two different roots, so its look-alikes are -ary and qu- words, while its near group holds extraction and hunting terms.
note.cn: quarry 有两条不同词源，所以形近组收 -ary 结尾或 qu- 开头的词，近义组则收开采与狩猎方面的词。

normalIntro.en: Quarry is easiest to keep when you see it as two words fused: a square-block stone pit and a hunted prey.
normalIntro.cn: 记 quarry 最容易的办法是把它看成两个词合体：方石开采场与猎物。

normal.en: Latin quadrus, a square stone, is the same root as square.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 quadrus（方形石块）与 square（方形）同根。

normal.en: The plural is quarries and the verb adds -ed to give quarried.
normal.cn: 复数是 quarries，动词加 -ed 得到 quarried。

normal.en: A quarryman is the person who works inside a quarry.
normal.cn: quarryman 就是在采石场里干活的采石工。

normal.en: Mine tends to mean metal or coal, while quarry means building stone.
normal.cn: mine 多指金属矿或煤矿，quarry 则指建筑石料。

normal.en: The prey sense has a separate French origin, so do not link it to the stone sense.
normal.cn: 猎物义另有法语来源，不要把它和石料义扯上词源关系。

examples.cn: 那座废弃的采石场如今成了热门的游泳地点。

examples.en: Builders quarried the granite from a hillside nearby.
examples.cn: 建筑商从附近的山坡上开采花岗岩。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「快利」——采石场的工具又快又锋利，一凿就是一块方石；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 石料义：拉丁语 quadrare（使成方形）与 quadrus（方形石块）→ 古法语 quarriere（采石场）→ quarry；猎物义另来自古法语 coree（分给猎犬的猎获内脏），两者拼写相同而来源不同。

sensesIntro.en: Quarry begins with the stone pit, turns into the act of cutting stone, and then follows a second root to hunted prey and finally to any pursued target.
sensesIntro.cn: quarry 从采石场开始，转成开采石料的动作，再沿另一条词源走向猎物，最后泛指任何被追逐的目标。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hillside carved into square steps of cut stone.
core.cn: 核心意象：山坡被凿成一级级方形石阶。

branches.en: The stone pit is the concrete core sense.
branches.cn: 采石场是具体核心义项。

branches.en: Cutting stone is the action sense.
branches.cn: 开采石料是动作义项。

branches.en: Hunted prey comes from the second root.
branches.cn: 猎物义来自第二条词源。

branches.en: Any pursued target is the metaphorical extension.
branches.cn: 任何被追逐的目标是比喻延伸义项。

branches.en: Hunted animals and pursued suspects are both called a quarry.
branches.cn: 被猎的动物和被追的嫌疑人都被叫作 quarry。

intro.en: Quarry takes the Latin square-root through Old French, and in English it builds quarryman and the -ing noun quarrying.
intro.cn: quarry 经由古法语承接拉丁语的「方形」词根，在英语里又构成 quarryman 与 -ing 名词 quarrying。

latinIntro.en: Latin quadrus and quadrare give the square-block idea behind the stone sense, and the same root gives English square.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quadrus 与 quadrare 给出石料义背后的「方形石块」观念，同一词根也给出英语 square。

items.example: Quadrare gives the squaring image behind the stone sense.
items.exampleCN: quadrare 提供石料义背后「使成方形」的意象。

items.example: Quadrus explains why quarry means cut blocks.
items.exampleCN: quadrus 解释了 quarry 为何与切好的方石有关。

items.example: Quarriere carries the stone sense into English.
items.exampleCN: quarriere 把石料义带入英语。

items.meaning: a place where stone is cut

items.exampleCN: 动词 quarry 拼写不变。
